observations.name: stale-before-request
observations.detail: A revision already stale when delete starts refuses with412 and preserves the exact human row.

observations.name: history-survives-delete
observations.detail: Deleted draft is absent and its exact revision remains retrievable.

observations.name: restore-preserves-later-human-edit
observations.detail: Later title "New human title after recovery" became "Human edit before deletion" after replay.

observations.name: create-only-copy-preserves-both-rows
observations.detail: New identity preserves exact native blocks/title; repeated create refuses and retains later edits on both original and copy. Links are not retargeted.

observations.name: exact-delete-preserves-published-twin
observations.detail: Exact drafts.welcome delete returned200; published welcome read returned404.

observations.name: atomic-caller-revision-delete
observations.detail: Not executed: mutation revision check precedes lifecycle reread. Server-side interleaving test required.

safetyDecision: Do not expose generic delete or unconditional restore; implement exact-row atomic caller-revision deletion upstream before the native adapter.
visualReview: No application, dependency, pin or capture input changed. C069 reviewed evidence remains applicable; no new deletion UI is claimed.
limits: HTTP contract evidence, not a native deletion/recovery feature or stage acceptance.
The caller-revision/reread interval is a source-inferred race; this probe does not force that interleaving.
Copy recovery tests one native block snapshot; media, references, Pages placement, durable retry journals and profile isolation need adapter proof.
